text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that Wiltshire Avenue, between Davenport Road and Connolly Street be converted from the street specific program to an area based program, for permit parking, within permit parking area "3D". Transportation Services recommends approval of this proposal because it will allow greater parking flexibility for the residents on this segment specifically, and all residents within the area generally.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended Schedule B of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to convert Wiltshire Avenue, between Davenport Road and Connolly Street, from a "Street Specific" license to an "Area Based" license within permit parking area 3D.
